nodes.procedure: Electrochemical activation of YFe0.6Mn0.4O3 at an OER potential of 1.6 V for 20 minutes in a 1 M KOH electrolyte under 90 °C, forming YFe0.6Mn0.4O3@YFeOOH which maintains a similar morphology and structure to the original YFe0.6Mn0.4O3.
